Apartment Classic bei Home in Berlin MENU CLOSE Book Now Locations Contact Community Updates FAQ/Download Back to overview Apartment Classic 2 Room | 39 m² | available from 01. Sep 2026 maximum occupancy: 2 Berlin Wedding | Lynarstraße Map 949,00 € / Month Apply to rent Description Your Apartment Classic – right in the heart of Berlin. This centrally located apartment offers two sleeping and living areas, your own private kitchen, and a bathroom you share exclusively as a duo – perfect for friends, roommates, or couples who want to share a living space with plenty of room to live, study, and feel at home together. The green courtyard is ideal for relaxing, connecting with fellow students, or enjoying the barbecue area on sunny days. An excellent choice for anyone who wants to live together – with space, privacy, and a vibrant student community in the heart of the city. Facilities and amenities Rooms 2 Furnished yes Own bathroom yes Kitchenette yes Free Wi-Fi included yes Elevator no Balcony no TV/Sat/Cable no Barrier free no Common areas Shared bathroom no Community kitchen no In-house laundry center (charges apply) yes Garden/courtyard yes Bicycle parking space yes Location & Neighborhood Public Transportation – S-Bahn station Wedding, 2 min walk – Subway station Wedding, 2 min walk – Subway station Leopoldplatz, 5 min walk – Bus lines 120, 147, 5 min walk Universities and Colleges – Berliner Hochschule für Technik, 8 min walk – Humboldt University: 17 min – TU Berlin: 25 min – Universität der Künste: 30 min – Media University of Applied Science: 30 min by public transport Neighborhood – Central city Location – Sprengelkiez in Wedding – Supermarkets and stores Details Fully furnished: Two beds including duvet, pillow, and bed linen, closet, desk, shelf, mirror, dining table and chairs Private bathroom: shower, sink, mirror and WC Private kitchenette: hob, sink and fridge Services & Highlights Change of bed linen (every 4 weeks) Dishes can be purchased for a fee Community events Rules & preferences Tenant type: Students Age: 18-50+ Gender: No preference Pets allowed: No Playing Musical Instruments allowed: No Smoking allowed: No Costs Total rent including utilities: 949,00 € / Month Total deposit: 1.898,00 € available from: 01. Sep 2026 Important To Read Your booking is only final once we have received your valid student certificate and the payment of the deposit/first month’s rent. Your Way To Your Apartment – Step By Step Step 1 – „Book Now“ & register Please click the button „Book Now“ and create an Immomio account – this is required to submit your application. Registration = quick & easy. Step 2 – Confirm your email address After sending your request, you’ll receive an email . Please confirm your interest there – only then can we continue processing your application. Tip: The faster you confirm, the better your chances of getting your reservation. Step 3 – Upload your documents We require a current student certificate (your admission letter will suffice for now). Upload your documents under „Additional Documents“ . Step 4 – Wait while we review We’ll review your application (usually within 7 days ). You’ll receive updates by email automatically. Please note that we are unable to answer inquiries during this time. If you encounter an issue, we’ll reach out to you directly. Step 5 – Confirmation & rental contract Congratulations! Once everything is approved, you’ll get an email with the payment details for your deposit and first month’s rent . As soon as the payment is received, we’ll send you your rental contract for digital signature . Step 6 – Welcome to Berlin! Direct rental: viewings are usually not required. If you have any questions, our support team is happy to help.
